data.restrict_users: Restrict selected users from controlling entities in Home Assistant

data_description.restrict_users: When enabled, selected non-admin accounts are switched to Home Assistant Read Only. This blocks direct entity control throughout Home Assistant. Previous group memberships are restored if a user is removed here or this integration is removed. Read access to other entities is not restricted.
